entries.title: Fixed Four Fan Conoids and Open Crown Vault
entries.description: One complete newly authored static four-fan vault bay. A single continuous finite-thickness roof rises in four corner-centred trumpet-like conoidal fields, each with seven whole visible ribs radiating from a low corner spring and sweeping upward to the adjoining crown seams. Four complete piers have broad spring capitals and grounded feet. A real small square opening passes through the central crown and has its own complete narrow rim; four broad arched sides open onto the shared empty bay. Unlike the spherical sail vault the surface is not one cap centred over the bay, and unlike the groin vault it is not the maximum of two crossed cylindrical roofs. Its corner-centred fan curvature, open crown and fully integrated radial rib layout are authored together, not old vault meshes with added decoration. Four opaque constant untextured stone-look PBR roles, metre-style Z up and centred full horizontal bounds at ground soles, one architectural model zero scenes. Artistic fan-vault-inspired exterior only; not a precise historical reconstruction or construction design. No thrust, equilibrium, load bearing, weather sealing, installation, modular fit, access, building-code or structural safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Whole Friction Waist and Cutaway Box Drum Inspection Bay
entries.description: One static small percussion-inspection preparation bay, one scene and zero new independent models. entries.title: Fixed Hinged Twin Lattice and Long Grip Grilling Basket
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty static grilling-basket-inspired hand tool. The upper half is fixed raised about the shared rear transverse hinge, not a second loose basket. Each half carries a complete long paired-rod handle ending in a blank chamfered brown grip. entries.title: Fixed Hairpin Stepped Pools and Side Slots
entries.description: One complete newly authored static hairpin stepped-pool channel. A single connected grounded finite-thickness body contains a high left entrance, three descending left-flight floor terraces, one broad rear turning pool, and three descending right-return terraces ending at a low front exit beside the entrance. A full central divider ends before the rear pool, leaving the real U-turn open. Four complete cross-baffles in the two parallel flights have true full-height side slots alternating between outside bank and centre divider. The surrounding banks step with the floors and have complete upper coping surfaces. Unlike the old right-angle drop drain this is a returned dual-flight channel with an internal long divider and rear turning chamber, not a perpendicular two-mouth elbow or added covers. Unlike the two-well reclaim basin it has two open front channel mouths, a full folded route, stepped return and alternating full-height baffle gaps rather than a local weir saddle and small side outlets. All visible coordinates newly authored as one closed body, no older mesh imported. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre-style Z up and bounds-centred ground sole, one civil-architecture model zero scenes.
